title: Daktronics Says SEC, NBA Seek Information on Kawhi Leonard
summary: Daktronics has found itself in the middle of an NBA controversy. The maker of scoreboards and large video displays said Wednesday that both the Securities and Exchange Commission and the NBA have requested information from the company in connection with Los Angeles Clippers star Kawhi Leonard. “We have received requests for information from the NBA,” acting Chief Financial Officer Howard Atkins said on Daktronics’ fiscal first-quarter earnings call on Wednesday.
